css: .log-message { margin-bottom: 1em; } .log-message header { font-weight: bold; } .log-whisper { margin: 0 0 0.2em; font-size: 0.8em; color: #6b6b6b; } .log-quote { margin: 0 0 0.3em; padding-left: 0.6em; border-left: 2px solid #ccc; font-size: 0.8em; color: #6b6b6b; } .log-cover { break-after: page; text-align: center; } .log-page-break { break-after: page; } .log-embed--world-clue { padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; } .log-clue { margin: 0.3em 0; padding: 0.5em 0.75em; border: 1px solid #cccccc; border-radius: 4px; } .log-clue__head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.2em 0.5em; break-after: avoid; } .log-clue__label, .log-clue__kind { padding: 0; border: 0; font-size: 0.75em; color: #6b6b6b; } .log-clue__title { font-weight: bold; } .log-clue__media img { display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 20em; margin: 0.3em 0; } .log-clue__body--empty { color: #6b6b6b; } .log-clue__source { font-size: 0.8em; color: #6b6b6b; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
